Messages.Body:
I have a question about the "new" dodge?
Does it prevents other S:CE effects like earth meld or majesty or Form of mist??

Enrique

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:


Dodge only avoids strike effects on the dodging minion, all other effects
resolve normally. So Earth Meld, Majesty, Form of Mist, etc, still work the
same way you're used to.

Flux

Messages.Author: Ankur Gupta
Messages.Body:
> I have a question about the "new" dodge? Does it prevents other S:CE
> effects like earth meld or majesty or Form of mist??

No, since dodge only protects the minion using the dodge from effects of
the opposing minion's strike. None of the effects you've mentioned above
(untapping or continuing an action) affect that minion.

See other posts on the subject. . . I think it's mentioned somewhere.

Ankur
